preconditions.description: The number of railway stations n is between 2 and 5000 inclusive.
The number of railway sections is exactly n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each railway section connects two distinct stations within the range 1 to n.
The number of passengers m is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and 1 <= g <= 10**6 for a, b, g in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies two distinct stations within the range 1 to n and a scenery beauty value between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.split()) == n - 1 and all(1 <= int(f) <= 10**6 for f in return_value.split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 indicating no valid scenery beauty values exist, or a list of n-1 integers each between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' or any(any(g > min(int(f) for f in path) for a, b, g in queries) for path in all_paths)
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, there exists at least one query where the minimum scenery beauty along the path is greater than the minimum value in any valid path.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(min(int(f) for f in path) >= g for a, b, g in queries for path in all_paths if path[0] == a and path[-1] == b)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the minimum scenery beauty along the path between any queried stations is at least the specified value.
